info.name: GitHub Get All Requested Reviewers for Pull Request

params.name: owner
params.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: pull_number
params.description: The number that identifies the pull request.

items.docs: Gets the users or teams whose review is requested for a pull request. Once a requested reviewer submits a review, they are no longer considered a requested reviewer. Their review will instead be returned by the [List reviews for a pull request](https://docs.github.com/enterprise-server@3.9/rest/pulls/reviews#list-reviews-for-a-pull-request) operation.

info.name: GitHub Remove Requested Reviewers from Pull Request

params.name: owner
params.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: pull_number
params.description: The number that identifies the pull request.

items.docs: Removes review requests from a pull request for a given set of users and/or teams.
